- Source: https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail
- Upstream revision used for this port: `974d940a1c5344210874150b98ff0d2c861fab6a`
- Derived material: `skills/ponytail/SKILL.md`, `skills/ponytail-review/SKILL.md`, `hooks/ponytail-config.js`, `hooks/ponytail-instructions.js`, and mode-tracking semantics from `hooks/ponytail-mode-tracker.js`.
